C0918.title: U.S. Busts $200 Million International Credit Card Fraud Ring, 18 Indicted
C0918.summary: In February 2013, federal agents arrested 13 suspects in New Jersey and other states for alleged participation in a large international credit card fraud scheme. Prosecutors said the defendants fabricated thousands of identities, obtained tens of thousands of credit cards, doctored credit reports, and caused at least $200 million in confirmed losses, making it one of the largest credit card fraud cases charged by the DOJ at the time.
